BackstoryDef.title: brood alcove youth
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] first years in crowded nursery chambers where every gesture carried a lesson about rank, danger and restraint. Before [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to join a hunt, [PAWN_pronoun] already knew how to hold ground and read another creature's intent.

BackstoryDef.title: organ-deck youth
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up aboard a vessel whose walls healed, flexed and answered to careful tending. [PAWN_pronoun] learned early that Wraith machines are living systems, and that keeping them useful requires observation more than brute force.

BackstoryDef.title: reserve-chamber ward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised near chambers where prey were kept alive for future feeding. The work around [PAWN_objective] demanded attention to wounds, fear and hunger alike, leaving [PAWN_objective] unusually observant of living bodies.

BackstoryDef.title: culling outrider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] moved ahead of culling forces to study terrain, patrol routes and likely escape paths. A successful outing depended on finding a way in without warning the prey and a way out with captives still alive.

BackstoryDef.title: solitary pursuer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hunted travellers and stragglers beyond settlement walls, often for days at a time. [PAWN_pronoun] became skilled at deciding whether a target should be taken at range, rushed, or followed until capture was safer.

BackstoryDef.title: assault carapace guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fought in the dense centre of Wraith assaults, absorbing fire while quicker hunters searched for openings. Years of hard contact made [PAWN_objective] more comfortable advancing under pressure than waiting behind cover.

BackstoryDef.title: hull breach fighter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] specialised in fighting through airlocks, corridors and damaged hull sections where lines of fire vanished in seconds. [PAWN_pronoun] trained to switch between ranged and close combat without hesitation.

BackstoryDef.title: war-cell coordinator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] directed several small hunting and assault groups at once, translating a senior Wraith's intent into practical orders. The role rewarded fast judgement, clear authority and enough weapons training to survive when coordination failed.

BackstoryDef.title: harvest strike leader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] commanded raids where destroying resistance was secondary to returning with viable prey. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to keep aggressive subordinates focused on extraction, timing and the survival of the captured.

BackstoryDef.title: hibernation tender
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] watched over sleeping Wraith during long dormant intervals, maintaining cradle organs and correcting biological failures before they became fatal. The work demanded steady medical judgement and careful technical attention.

BackstoryDef.title: feeding reserve keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed a finite population of prey through lean periods, deciding who could feed and how much damage the captives could survive. [PAWN_pronoun] needed enough medical skill to preserve the reserve and enough presence to deny hungry Wraith.

BackstoryDef.title: lineage arbiter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] held together a dangerous lineage by deciding disputes, feeding priorities, migrations and wars. [PAWN_possessive] authority depended as much on anticipating consequences as on making others obey.

BackstoryDef.title: brood continuity matriarch
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] supervised the biological continuity of a hive across births, losses and long periods of scarcity. [PAWN_pronoun] combined political command with practical knowledge of Wraith health and population planning.

BackstoryDef.title: orphaned hunt scout
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lost contact with the hive during a distant hunt and survived without its normal support. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to repair what [PAWN_pronoun] could, negotiate when violence was wasteful and make decisions without a superior voice.

BackstoryDef.title: self-exiled Wraith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] chose exile rather than continued obedience to [PAWN_possessive] former hive. Independent survival forced [PAWN_objective] to explain unfamiliar needs to outsiders, study alternatives and manage [PAWN_possessive] own health without a caste structure behind [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: living-tech salvager
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] survived after an isolated Wraith holding collapsed, keeping fragments of living technology functional with scarce biomass and improvised tools. The experience made [PAWN_objective] patient with damaged systems and reluctant to waste biological resources.
